Создано в Казахстане · начинаем с пекаре: Created in Kazakhstan · starting with bakeries in Astana
SAQTA — технология для пекарен, которым: SAQTA is a technology for bakeries that need to plan their bakes more accurately and find buyers for suitable leftovers. The name is inspired by the Kazakh “sakta”: preserve, preserve, protect.
Платное направление продукта: история пр: Paid product direction: sales history, explainable forecast, recommendation taking into account stock and checking on previous days. The scenario calculator helps you estimate the possible reduction in write-off costs.
Бесплатное размещение пригодных к продаж: Free placement of salable stock on all tariffs. The bakery sets the price and pickup window, and the buyer places a demo order. The quantity is reserved in the database; cancellation returns the reserve. Business Model Commission - 5% of the discounted amount of a completed sale, no posting, reserve or cancellation fees. Payments and transfers are not integrated.
